kicker: SCION 094 · FRAMING, GESTURE, CITY RHYTHMS & VIDEO ESSAYS
title: Chuck Jones — How Constraint Changes Performance
subtitle: From full-body slapstick and stage spectacle to minimal eye-line and rule-governed timing
lineage: Lineage: Tony Zhou & Taylor Ramos, Chuck Jones: The Evolution of an Artist (Every Frame a Painting, 2015)
theorem: Demonstrate how formal constraints sharpen performance across time: move from early broad full-body spectacle and slapstick contraptions to a strict rule-bound frame where a single eye movement or stillness carries the entire reaction.
boundary_note: Compares broad early-cinema physical performance (`87f91a18`, `aea2e0ee`) with rule-governed animated/minimal reaction (`8cb57143`, `33e285cf`, `f6076ebb`) using side-by-side analytical replay.

critic_tribunal.largest_gap: Contrasts broad physical comedy (`87f91a18` 1914, `aea2e0ee` 1923) with rule-bound animation (`8cb57143` 1959, `33e285cf` 1955) and micro-expression eye timing (`f6076ebb` 1941).
